mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, icon, path, component, route_name, permissions, menu_type, sort, status, visible, is_cache, is_external, client_type, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT MAX(sort) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.permissions FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.permissions IS NOT NULL AND m.permissions != ''
